rotation: Given the high severity of persistent inflationary pressures and monetary policy uncertainty, sectors with pricing power and defensiveness, such as consumer staples and healthcare, are favored. Conversely, technology and consumer discretionary sectors are pressured due to potential interest rate hikes and slowing global growth.
